text:
ana: dropped a new design pass for Playground streaming + prompt shelf insert. looking for quick UX + a11y checks. figs linked in comments.

ana: TL;DR: make stopping feel graceful, surface token usage more clearly (mobile + desktop), and streamline prompt-shelf insert without stealing focus.

liam: like the fast shimmer -> text reveal. question: when a user hits Stop should we keep partial output editable or lock it?

ana: proposal: keep partial output editable so users can tweak, but mark it with a subtle faded badge "partial". Try again button restarts generation from same prompt.

sofia: a11y nit: use `aria-label=\"Stop generation, preserve partial result\"` and when stopped announce: `aria-live=\"assertive\"` "Generation stopped; partial result kept."

mark: backend: we can keep KV snapshot for 7s by default for fast try again. recommend client debounce 450ms to avoid spamming regen.

liam: button styling: Try again should be low-emphasis outline, not primary. users reflexively click regen if it's heavy.

sofia: keyboard: map `Esc` to Stop, `Ctrl/Cmd+R` to Try again. ensure `Esc` doesn't break screen reader focus. add tabindex for prompt insert buttons.

ana: token counter proposals: A) composer inline (left of send) B) compact header badge that appears after 3+ messages. we should A/B test. counter tooltip copy: "Estimated compute tokens billed for this conversation."

mark: client will stream live token updates (200ms throttle). clicking counter expands a small panel with per-turn rows + export CSV. mobile opens modal.

liam: micro-interaction: on prompt insert, animate a 120ms soft highlight and keep cursor position if `preserveCursor=true`. add that flag to the insert API.

sofia: accessibility: insertion should announce politely: `aria-live=\"polite\"` "Prompt inserted: <title>" and focus remains in composer for editing. also ensure color contrast on token badge.

ana: copy tweak: replace "Tokens used" with "Compute tokens" (accepted). use "Try again" instead of "Regenerate" for clarity and localization.

mark: rate-limit: server enforces per-user try-again quota; client shows cooldown (small countdown badge) and `aria-disabled` true while cooling. toast on expiry: "Fast retry unavailable — warming model".

liam: mobile nit: avoid tiny footer counters; use a tappable token indicator near composer. ensure large tap targets for Stop/Try again.

qa-bot: Reminder: design review meeting scheduled at 1901235000 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

ana: assigning: owner=ana, followups=@liam (micro-interaction + counter A/B), @mark (KV window + debounce + cooldown UI), @sofia (a11y copy + keyboard flows). will upload updated figma and test scenarios before the sync. thanks! :seedling:
